## Summary of findings

This candidate is a proxy info-test that labels ribbon_ride signals with QQQ agreement (reclaimed/failed/none) to model a spot-return proxy over the next 30 minutes. It does not produce a direct P&L score; real-fills replay is the funded next step. Walk-forward OOS testing for P&L is not applicable.
